General Fund column: printed Fund balances end of year 2,624,895 vs the governmental funds balance sheet (p3) General Fund 635,584 (= 595,568 + 40,016). The Total column (2,360,681) is consistent and was used

A second Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (pp8-9, report pp31-32) prints different figures (operating revenues 2,904,767, expenses 2,241,029, ending net position 9,358,214) from the basic statement p6 (ending 9,037,533, which ties to the Statement of Net Position). p6 used; pp8-9 not recorded
Proprietary Statement of Cash Flows ending cash 2,850,340 (Sewer 566,216) vs Statement of Net Position cash 2,850,265 (Sewer 566,141); p10 operating cash 1,054,869 vs p11 reconciliation 1,054,794

notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4); beginning_cash/ending_cash are the printed total fund balances (p4; balance sheet p3 total cash 2,360,681, no liabilities). Debt proceeds 500,000 and sale of assets 104,036 (Other Governmental Funds). Business-type from the proprietary revenues/expenses statement p6 (measure net position since it rolls net position incl. capital assets); receipts total computed (operating 2,556,567 + nonoperating 28,863). Business spending lines split by column: Golf Course as culture/recreation, the rest by cost type with function utilities. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position p1 (capital assets and debt). Detail: per-fund lines from the p4 fund columns (General, Bond and Interest, Street, Fire Hall) and p6 proprietary fund columns; Other Governmental Funds from the p12 combining schedule Total column (12 funds, Nonmajor funds (combined)). The all-funds budget schedule p7 is not recorded (combined all funds; per-fund lines used). The second proprietary statement (pp8-9) disagrees with p6 and is not recorded. Transfer cross-check: governmental in 1,682,009 + business in 178,770 = out 1,487,779 + 373,000 = 1,860,779 (budget schedule p7), no hidden transfers. Read pages 1-12 of 12
